#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a Team Meeting ICS event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
import datetime
import uuid

# --- Compute next Wednesday (strictly after today; if today is Wednesday, use +7) ---
today = datetime.date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == 2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
meeting_date = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Event times (local, America/New_York) ---
dtstart_local = datetime.datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0)
dtend_local = datetime.datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 16, 0)
now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

def fmt_local(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill.local"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
TZID:America/New_York
BEGIN:STANDARD
DTSTART:19701101T020000
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=11;BYDAY=1SU
TZOFFSETFROM:-0400
TZOFFSETTO:-0500
TZNAME:EST
END:STANDARD
BEGIN:DAYLIGHT
DTSTART:19700308T020000
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=3;BYDAY=2SU
TZOFFSETFROM:-0500
TZOFFSETTO:-0400
TZNAME:EDT
END:DAYLIGHT
END:VTIMEZONE
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(now_utc)}
DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:{fmt_local(dtstart_local)}
DTEND;TZID=America/New_York:{fmt_local(dtend_local)}
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Weekly team meeting
LOCATION:
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)

# --- Validation ---
lines = ics.splitlines()
assert ics.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") and ics.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR")
assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in ics and "END:VEVENT" in ics
assert "SUMMARY:Team Meeting" in ics
assert "DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:" in ics
assert "DTEND;TZID=America/New_York:" in ics
assert "UID:" in ics and "DTSTAMP:" in ics

print("Created team_meeting.ics")
print(f"Date: {meeting_date} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: 3:00 PM America/New_York")
print(f"End:   4:00 PM America/New_York")
print("Validation: PASSED")
